metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neurocom 23-channel monopolar system at 500 Hz, using 10/20 electrode placement and interconnected ear electrode references. Filters were a 0.5 Hz high-pass, a 45 Hz low-pass, and a 50 Hz notch. Participants had a 3-minute adaptation period, then 3 minutes of eyes-closed rest, then a 4-minute mental arithmetic task (4-digit minuend minus 2-digit subtrahend). The dataset stores the last 180 s of rest and the first 60 s of the task. Only artifact-free segments were retained.
